limitations: Finite repeated generation is not a proof of eventual coverage.
Current exact owner approvals and frozen native policies remain enabled.
Exposure is committed by the harness only after each verified generated list; there is no UI in this diagnostic.
Elapsed times are observational and may include contention from other audits.
Per-tie eligibility is based on the existing bounded source/candidate review; no exhaustive global-optimum claim.
Weather, style, garment locks, learned preferences and the owner device history are not reproduced.
